schedule.description: Michael King — Cubs Now in Play

stories.title: Gold Gloves — PCA Back-to-Back + Bregman Makes History

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
TWO GOLD GLOVES. One night.

Pete Crow-Armstrong wins CF for the SECOND straight year (26 OAA, best in baseball).

Alex Bregman takes 3B — only the second Cub to win the award at that position ever.

Ron Santo was the first. Let that land.

#Cubs #GoCubs #CubsBaseball

stories.title: Bregman / Ron Santo — Bold Historical Take

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
BREGMAN IS ALREADY IN RARE COMPANY.

Ron Santo won five straight Gold Gloves at third base for this franchise (1964–68). Nothing for 58 years.

In his first Cubs season, Alex Bregman joins that list.

The Bregman signing looks better every week.

#Cubs #ChicagoCubs #MLB

stories.title: Ian Happ QO — Decision Due TODAY

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
FIVE HOURS.

That's how long the Cubs have to decide whether to extend Ian Happ a $23.15M qualifying offer.

.218 BA. 24 HR. Gold Glove finalist who lost. The front office's call by 5 PM ET.

However it goes, the offseason starts for real today.

#Cubs #MLB #CubsBaseball

stories.title: Michael King — Cubs Now Free to Bid

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
KING IS FREE.

Padres' exclusive window closes today — he's now available to every team, including the Cubs.

3.21 ERA. 32 starts. 0.64 ERA in the postseason. Hoyer spent all winter chasing him.

The rotation overhaul starts now.

#Cubs #MLB #GoCubs

stories.title: Cubs Rotation Crisis — Five Starters in Free Agency

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
FIVE STARTERS. All free agents. Right now.

Imanaga. Gausman. Peterson. Holmes. Boyd.

Horton's out until July 2027. Every rotation spot is open.

Hoyer has one job this winter.

#Cubs #NorthSiders #MLB

stories.title: Jason Kanzler / Mariners — Decision Expected This Week

x_posts.label: Post 6
x_posts.text:
KANZLER OR ESPADA — Mariners' decision coming this week.

Cubs farm director Kanzler is a finalist. If he wins, Chicago loses the architect of its prospect pipeline.

One of the most important hires to watch in baseball right now.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

stories.title: Dominick Reid AFL — Leading the League in Strikeouts

x_posts.label: Post 7
x_posts.text:
14 STRIKEOUTS. Three starts. 1.50 ERA.

Dominick Reid is leading the Arizona Fall League in punchouts, coming back from a mid-2026 impingement.

His changeup is a 60-grade pitch. Building toward six offerings.

This farm system isn't done.

#Cubs #GoCubs #ChicagoCubs
